constructRecommendation: Set RIP should measure a set's average relative ripping quality across eligible sealed-product families. Within each family, all rankable SKU standings are averaged; available eligible family means are then averaged with one equal vote per family.

familyCountFairness.interpretation: Coverage is a rankability gate only. Every eligible family contributes one vote, regardless of its SKU count. In the current cohort, higher family coverage is negatively rather than positively associated with Set RIP, so this diagnostic does not show a systematic more-families advantage.

historicalEvidence.reason: No stored historical product-family projections with current canonical model versions were found; historical Monte Carlo was not rerun.

knownLimitations: Half Booster Box and Enhanced Booster Box currently have no or insufficient canonical coverage.
Verified deferred products are missing evidence, not poor performance.
22 sets currently clear the leading candidate's gate; this is research coverage, not a validated public Set RIP cohort.
Related pack formats may count correlated evidence more than once; group-balanced results are retained as a sensitivity architecture.

methodologyRecommendation: Leading research candidate: mean SKU standing within each canonical product family, then an unshrunk equal-family arithmetic mean. A set needs at least two eligible families; a family needs at least three represented sets. Missing families are omitted, never zero, and SKU-rich families receive no extra weight.

priorResearch.reason: The prior numeric artifacts selected sealed-product runs through one market date instead of each ranked target's calculation_run_id. The pre-registered 189-configuration methodology is unchanged; all numeric findings were recomputed.

canonicalVersions.reason: Mixed, fallback, or superseded canonical versions fail closed.

deferredCoverage.reason: The verified deferred cohort must be scored through the normal artifact-backed workflow.

familyCohortQuality.reason: Only families meeting the generic represented-set threshold may contribute.

familyCountFairness.reason: This is a diagnostic review guardrail, not a formula-tuning target.

leaveOneFamilyOutStability.reason: All informative participating-family omissions must satisfy every stability guardrail.

multiSkuInvariant.reason: Multiple SKUs may affect only their set-family arithmetic mean and never create duplicate final votes.

representativeSensitivity.reason: BEST or MEDIAN crossing a warning threshold stops promotion for methodology review; group-balanced is diagnostic only.

runAuthority.reason: Every included row must match its owning ranked target calculation_run_id.

setCoverage.reason: Sets below two participating families remain unavailable, never zero.

rawScorePolicy: Raw Overall RIP and Financial RIP values are excluded from the matrix and every consensus calculation.
